title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1983-08-29
lineage: cass > Nakamichi BX-125E > EMU 0202 > Wavelab 6 > wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition 1.5 > Wavelab 6 (with iZotope Ozone 4) > iZotope RX Advanced > wav 16/44.1 > CD Wave > flac 16

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with mixed sound quality – praised for tight bass and opera‑house ambience by one reviewer, but others report blown‑out, saturated levels making it unlistenable.
ai_review.review: The show itself receives little commentary beyond a note that the Hult Center bass sounded tight and perfect. Recording quality is contentious: some listeners describe an amazing, clear balcony capture, while others say the levels are completely blown out and the tape is practically unlistenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give widely divergent scores (0, 1, 5) and conflicting remarks about audio quality; with no musical details, the rating leans low due to prevalent complaints of blown‑out levels.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers note totally blown‑out and saturated levels making parts unlistenable; one reviewer praises the tight, perfect bass and an opera‑house‑like ambience from a balcony position.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or song flow were provided in the reviews.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as tight and perfect by one reviewer.
